upstream.revisionPolicy: The checkpoint is dual-licensed Apache-2.0 and OpenMDW-1.0 with the user selecting the license; evaluation must record the selected license and the exact checkpoint revision before any use.

materialChanges: About 385M-parameter time-series foundation model (ibm-granite/granite-timeseries-patchtst-fm-r2) built from conformer blocks mixing multi-head self-attention with temporal convolutions (kernel sizes 5, 5, 3, 3) across 30 blocks, with 50 percent overlapping patches, Hamming windows and overlap-and-add reconstruction, supporting context up to 8,192 points, 99 predicted quantiles, probabilistic forecasting and imputation.

Upstream reports GIFT-Eval zero-shot replicable leaderboard rank 2 (CRPS 0.467 geomean, MASE 0.6846) and rank 1 among permissively licensed models, from a fully documented pretraining corpus (selected GIFT-Eval pretraining datasets, KernelSynth and CauKer synthetic data; TSMixup restricted to exclude GIFT-Eval evaluation data). All leaderboard numbers are UPSTREAM_REPORTED_NOT_SZL_MEASURED.
Weights, training code and data recipe are published for reproducibility; inference served through granite-tsfm version 0.3.9 or later.
Material for the SZL quant/finance and telemetry drift planes; materiality 89/100 from python-admission intake; production disposition HOLD.

acceptance: Pin the exact checkpoint revision and record the selected license (Apache-2.0 or OpenMDW-1.0) before evaluation; dual licensing requires an explicit recorded selection.

Reproduce zero-shot probabilistic forecasting on fixed non-secret SZL time-series fixtures in the quant/finance and telemetry lanes, or record honest UNAVAILABLE; never transcribe GIFT-Eval scores as SZL measurements.
Independently assess the documented-corpus leakage boundary where feasible; a documented pretraining corpus is an upstream claim, not leakage-proof evidence.
Keep provider routing, model publication and automatic promotion false until separate normal controls pass; no weight rehosting.
